decisions.subject: Pipeline selection for mixed source footage plus support graphics

options_considered.label: hybrid
options_considered.reason: Matches avatar footage, uploaded screen recording, title cards, and captions.

options_considered.label: screen-demo
options_considered.reason: Would under-serve the avatar intro and end card.
options_considered.rejected_because: Too narrow for the full asset mix.

options_considered.label: talking-head
options_considered.reason: Would under-serve the screen recording and title cards.
options_considered.rejected_because: Too narrow for the full asset mix.

decisions.subject: Render runtime under the user's free-local-tools constraint

options_considered.label: Remotion composition + FFmpeg downscale
options_considered.reason: Remotion supports text cards and captions; FFmpeg finishes at 1280x720.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: Available in registry but excluded by the user's FFmpeg/Remotion constraint.
options_considered.rejected_because: Out of scope under explicit constraint.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg only
options_considered.reason: Cannot create the planned Remotion-style title cards and word captions as cleanly.

decisions.reason: Best fit for the requested runtime constraint and the support-layer plan.

decisions.subject: Renderer family

options_considered.label: explainer-data
options_considered.reason: Explainer composition supports mixed cuts, text cards, captions, and audio.

options_considered.label: screen-demo
options_considered.reason: Would constrain the title and end-card treatment.
options_considered.rejected_because: Less suitable for mixed scene types.

decisions.reason: Chosen for reliable cut-based composition with caption support.

decisions.subject: Human approval policy for this run

options_considered.label: Full run pre-authorized
options_considered.reason: User explicitly asked to write, validate, render, and report produced files in one run.

options_considered.label: Gate-by-gate approval
options_considered.reason: Would interrupt the explicitly requested end-to-end run.
options_considered.rejected_because: User already requested the full run.

decisions.reason: Explicit full-run instruction recorded at the moment it was given.
